label: Copper
info: Red-orange metal known for high electrical and thermal conductivity.

discovery.appearance: Reddish metallic luster; green patina when weathered
discovery.notes: Look for green or blue staining on rocks; heavy relative to size.

recipe: Crush ore and concentrate via flotation or gravity methods
Roast concentrate to remove sulfur and moisture
Smelt in furnace to produce matte (copper-iron sulfide)
Convert matte in converter furnace to blister copper (~98% pure)
Fire-refine and electrolytically refine to 99.99% cathode copper
